page.heading: Skills
page.subtitle: Reusable instructions attached to your agents' prompts.

empty.title: No skills yet
empty.body: Write one from scratch, or import it from a file.

selectPrompt.title: Select a skill
selectPrompt.body: Pick a skill on the left to view or edit it.

card.vettingTitle: Untrusted source — review and trust before enabling
card.runsTitle: Completed runs that used this skill in the last 30 days
card.noEvalsTitle: No full eval has run on this skill yet

detail.runOnEvalsTitle: Estimate and start an ablation eval

config.title: Configuration
config.name: Name
config.descriptionHint: The description is the skill's interface. Write it as a directive: Use when… Flags…
config.deleteConfirm: Delete skill "{name}"? This cannot be undone.
config.changeNoteHint: Optional. Stored with the new version.
config.draftBanner: Draft from v{version}. Nothing is saved until you press Save, which creates a new version.
config.draftUnavailable: v{version} body unavailable, so the editor shows the current version.

dirtyGuard.title: Discard changes?
dirtyGuard.body: This skill has unsaved changes. Leave without saving?

preview.title: Preview
preview.caption: Rendered as the reviewing agent receives it.
preview.commentWarning: This body contains HTML comments, hidden from the rendered view.
preview.invisibleWarning: This body contains invisible or bidirectional characters, marked below.

vet.title: Review & trust
vet.body: "{name}" came from an untrusted source. Read its body below before you enable it — once enabled, it becomes part of your agents' prompts.

versions.title: Versions
versions.caption: Each save of the name, description, type or body creates a new version. Old versions are never overwritten.
versions.loadError: Could not load the version history.
versions.label: v{version}
versions.unavailableHint: Saved before version history was recorded.

diff.nothingToCompare: Nothing to compare yet. This is the only version.
diff.heading: {from} → {to}

restoreModal.title: Restore v{version}
restoreModal.subtitle: Pick how to bring v{version} back. History is never rewritten.
restoreModal.editHint: Open v{version} in the editor as a draft. Saving creates a new version.
restoreModal.restoreHint: Create v{next} with the content of v{version} right away.
restoreModal.importedWarning: This skill was imported. A new body resets vetting, so agents stop using it until you review and trust it again.
restoreModal.stale: Skill changed since you opened it. Reload to see the latest version, then try again.
restoreModal.noopToast: v{version} already matches the current skill, so no new version was created.

create.title: Create skill
create.subtitle: A skill is a reusable instruction attached to one or more agents.

drawer.title: Add a skill
drawer.subtitle: Import a skill from a Markdown file or a zip archive.
drawer.trustBanner: This is someone else's instructions. Once enabled, it goes into your agent's prompt.
drawer.chooseFileHint: Markdown (.md) or a zip (.zip) archive, up to 1 MB.

errors.noSkillMd: No SKILL.md found at the archive root or one level deep.
errors.bomb: Archive expands past 5 MB once decompressed.
errors.badUtf8: SKILL.md is not valid UTF-8 text.

file.nameHint: Optional — derived from the file name when the file has no frontmatter.
file.bodyHint: Imported skills start disabled and unvetted — review the body before you enable them.
file.success: Imported "{name}". It stays disabled until you review and trust it.

verdict.staleTitle: The skill or its carrier agent changed since this eval ran

stats.title: Stats
stats.caption: How much this skill is used, what it costs, and whether it helps.
stats.loadError: Could not load stats for this skill.

impact.title: Impact
impact.unknownBody: No evals yet. An ablation eval runs a carrier agent with and without this skill to tell whether it helps.
impact.failed: The latest eval did not finish.
impact.passRateAria: {percent}% of cases pass with the skill
impact.deltaUnexpectedTitle: Unexpected findings per case, with the skill minus without it
impact.indicativeNote: Indicative only: a Quick run, or fewer than 5 stable cases. Run a Full eval for a verdict.
impact.staleNote: The skill or the carrier agent changed since this eval ran, so the verdict may no longer hold.

usage.title: Usage
usage.noAgents: No agent links this skill yet.

statusTitles.effective: The skill goes into this agent's prompt.
statusTitles.link_disabled: This agent's link to the skill is switched off.
statusTitles.blocked_by_vetting: The skill needs review and trust before agents use it.

cost.title: Cost
cost.caption: Skill tokens × completed runs, priced at each run's model.
